column1: # Compile-time scaling budgets (R-0550, ROADMAP Phase 1 exit 2o): the record
#   shape   NAME SIZES MODES        a generated shape, its sizes and the compiles it is timed by
#   exclude SHAPE STAGE REASON      a stage not judged, with the filed defect that keeps it out
#   exclude SHAPE STAGES REASON     stages (comma list, or *) not judged, with the filed defect or reason
# Budgets are re-measured (and this header restamped) only on the CI host class; a change that
# legitimately moves a stage re-measures, a change that breaks one fixes the compiler.
# Declaration and nesting shapes run at 2500 and 10000 while their stages above are excluded;
# their sizes move into 10^4 - 10^5 with the fixes. assignments runs at 40000 and 160000: below
# about 40000 the stages still fit the host's caches and grow faster than their algorithm.
# measured: commit 10b81a467a85855d9b60186ac2c98bf7a6219c3b on concrete-ci-2, AMD Ryzen 9 7950X3D 16-Core Processor, 32 threads, 2026-10-26, 3 runs (median), budget = max(4 x median, median + 200ms)
# exp: a stage whose allocations (heartbeats) grow exactly linearly still takes up to about
# n^1.4 in time between a size and four times it on these hosts (caches and the allocator at
# 10^5 elements); 1.5 (x8 over a 4x step) leaves room for that, and a quadratic stage (x16)
